description: WorkOS shared Renovate preset. Hardens GitHub Actions usage with SHA-pinned digests, a 7-day minimum release age, and grouped/automerged minor & patch updates. See README for details.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Constrain security-fix PRs to the same schedule as regular updates. Renovate's built-in default is schedule:[] (any time), which causes vulnerability-fix PRs to be opened and merged outside the designated time window.

packageRules.description: Group and automerge non-major (digest/pinDigest/minor/patch) GitHub Actions updates.
Major GitHub Actions updates require human review.
Disable major and minor updates for software dependencies — patch-only policy.

Automerge patch updates for software dependencies after minimum release age. Group by dependency name so monorepos with version-consistency policies (e.g. Rush) get a single PR per dependency across all packages.
Skip internal/private Docker registries that Renovate cannot resolve (dhi.io and ghcr.io/workos).
